description: This file implements functions and classes for incremental lookup in a fixed set data structure, specifically for string matching and retrieval within a DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). It includes methods for advancing through the automaton based on input characters, retrieving associated return values, and performing suffix-based lookups in reverse order.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: A class for incremental traversal and lookup within a fixed string set represented as a DAFSA.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the lookup state with a new input character, updating internal position pointers.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the result value associated with the current position in the automaton.
